description: This file defines the TextFormat class, a Drupal render element for handling text formats in forms, including processing, access control, and rendering logic.

classes.name: TextFormat
classes.description: A Drupal render element class for text format selection and processing within forms.

methods.description: Expands a form element into a structure with a text format selector, handling permissions and default formats.

methods.description: Render callback that replaces the value with an access denied message if user lacks permissions.
